mapping.candidateApprovalResponseRevision: new published entity revision, NOT immutable proposal revision

rules: No runtime adapter or new HTTP endpoint is added by this proposal.
Read both expectations from authoritative detail; never copy proposal revision into entity revision.
Open submitted proposal before decision only after explicit transition contract approval.
Confirm after refreshed detail, compare both expectations and state; reconcile uncertain outcome with exact same operation/body/key.
For an absent entity, zero is meaningful only if confirmed by the approved server contract; never infer it from missing data.
Reject/request_changes responses omit revision; do not default them to 1.
Unknown or unsafe-range numeric values lock decisions; never round, clamp or silently coerce.
